paragraph: Today's Granville composite reads a neutral 50 out of 100 with no breadth divergence warning active, suggesting a market caught in crosscurrents as it digests a calm 18.96 VIX and a stable dollar at $29.49 alongside rising 10-year real yields at 2.78%. Underlying participation shows a split personality, with bullish signals from equal-weight leadership up 0.65% and transport relative strength gaining 0.73%, yet heavy anchor is applied by bellwether semiconductors plunging 3.33% and aggressive risk appetite underperforming by 2.17%. Defensive rotation is firmly active with the XLP/XLY ratio rising 1.72%, while credit confidence remains quietly resilient as high-yield spreads tighten to 3.20% and HYG/LQD ticks up 0.16% against a normal contango volatility term structure. Ultimately, the tension between defensive safety-seeking and underlying structural participation keeps the tape range-bound, warranting a cautious, neutral-to-slightly-defensive directional lean for the upcoming session.
